templates.body:

It will be a relaxed gathering with food, music, and good company.

templates.body:
Thank you for taking the time to speak with me about [topic]. I wanted to follow up with a clear summary and a useful next step.

Based on what you shared, I believe [solution] could help your team move faster with less manual effort. I would be happy to walk you through the details this week.
